select s.sim_id, s.tree_id, s.category_node_id, coalesce(( select group_concat(distinct tbn.node_name order by tbn.node_id separator '、') from biz_tree_category_bind tcb inner join biz_tree_node tbn on tbn.node_id = tcb.node_id and tbn.del_flag = '0' where tcb.business_type = 'simCard' and tcb.business_id = s.sim_id and tcb.del_flag = '0' ), n.node_name) as category_node_name, s.imei, s.iccid, s.phone_number, s.monthly_data_quota, s.activation_time, s.expire_time, s.current_data_usage, s.status, s.create_time, s.remark, case when b.bind_id is null then false else true end as bound, b.vehicle_id as bound_vehicle_id, v.plate_no as bound_plate_no from biz_sim_card s left join biz_tree_node n on n.node_id = s.category_node_id and n.del_flag = '0' left join biz_vehicle_equipment_bind b on b.equipment_type = '3' and b.equipment_id = s.sim_id and b.del_flag = '0' left join biz_vehicle v on v.id = b.vehicle_id and v.del_flag = 0
s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and (b.bind_id is null or b.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId})
and ( s.iccid like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.imei like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or s.phone_number like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by s.iccid asc, s.sim_id desc

select s.sim_id, s.tree_id, s.category_node_id, coalesce(( select group_concat(distinct tbn.node_name order by tbn.node_id separator '、') from biz_tree_category_bind tcb inner join biz_tree_node tbn on tbn.node_id = tcb.node_id and tbn.del_flag = '0' where tcb.business_type = 'simCard' and tcb.business_id = s.sim_id and tcb.del_flag = '0' ), n.node_name) as category_node_name, s.imei, s.iccid, s.phone_number, s.monthly_data_quota, s.activation_time, s.expire_time, s.current_data_usage, s.status, s.create_time, s.remark from biz_sim_card s left join biz_tree_node n on n.node_id = s.category_node_id and n.del_flag = '0' where s.del_flag = '0' and s.sim_id in
#{simId}
